title: Card Machines by Business Type: Find the Right Setup
description: The right card machine and till depends on how you trade. Guides for shops, cafés, pubs, restaurants, salons, market stalls, tradespeople and petrol stations.
intro: A coffee shop, a corner shop and a forecourt need very different payment setups. Pick your business to see what usually fits, what to ask providers and which costs matter most.

image.alt: A customer paying by card at a salon counter

cardText: Shops, hospitality, salons, mobile traders and forecourts.

items.title: Shops & retail
items.text: Convenience stores, boutiques, gift shops and off-licences.

sections.html:
BusinessUsual setupPricing to look at
Market stall, pop-up, events4G reader or phone (Tap to Pay)Pay as you go, no monthly fee
Hairdresser, beauty, therapistReader or terminal + booking appPay as you go or subscription
Tradesperson, mobile services4G reader, pay by link, invoicesPay as you go; keyed and online rates
Café, takeawayTerminal + POS app or EPOSFlat rate vs quote; watch authorisation fees on small sales
Pub, restaurantHospitality EPOS + portable pay-at-table terminalsQuoted rates, terminal fees per device
Convenience store, retailEPOS with scanner + integrated countertop terminalQuoted rates once takings are higher
Petrol stationForecourt EPOS + pay-at-pump terminalsSpecialist forecourt providers + acquirer quote
